descriptionByLocale.en:
Have you ever wondered how your skills and unique background can affect the world of tomorrow? Become part of our supply management teams and use the talent and passion that makes you.

Supply Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution

As a supply manager at Tecan, you are a central part of our supply management team and ensure that our material supply runs smoothly. You optimize availability, quality and costs, develop our supplier relationships and contribute your ideas for efficient processes. With your commitment, you help us achieve our ambitious departmental and corporate goals – and inspire our customers worldwide.

• Independent procurement and support of suppliers and product lines within the framework of global and local procurement and quality policy

• Optimization of material availability, storage handling, quality and costs as well as continuous development of procurement and logistics processes

• Support in negotiating and concluding contracts with suppliers as well as actively developing supplier relationships

• Coordination and communication with internal and external interfaces, including processing of non-conformity reports and corrective actions

• Maintenance and collection of procurement master data in the ERP system (SAP R3/S4) as well as implementation of change requests and article entries

• Participation in internal projects.

Your profile

We are not just looking for expertise: we are looking for people who put their passion and talent to work with us.

• Technical or commercial training completed

• Ideally, a further development as a federal dipl. Buyer: in or comparable

• At least 2–3 years of experience in operational or strategic procurement

• Very good knowledge of German and English in word and writing

• Experience with SAP R3/S4 and Excel

• You are familiar with the national and international supplier market

• You are confident in negotiations, efficient, practical and self-confident

• Resilience, team spirit, communication strength and social competence distinguish you

• You are innovative, goal-oriented, reliable and think entrepreneurial

• Flexibility, willingness to learn and openness to new things round off your profile

What makes working at Tecan unique?

• The opportunity to make a difference and shape the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• Exciting career opportunities

• Strong and unique corporate culture

• Attractive remuneration and benefits

We look forward to your online application. For your application, we only need your CV (without photo and without letters of motivation, certificates and diplomas are optional).

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In qualità di responsabile dell'approvvigionamento di Tecan, sei una parte centrale del nostro team di gestione dell'offerta e assicurati che la nostra fornitura di materiale funzioni senza problemi. Ottimizzare la disponibilità, la qualità e i costi, sviluppare i nostri rapporti di fornitore e contribuire alle vostre idee per processi efficienti. Con il vostro impegno, ci aiutate a raggiungere i nostri ambiziosi obiettivi dipartimentali e aziendali – e ispirare i nostri clienti in tutto il mondo.

• Manutenzione e raccolta dei dati master di approvvigionamento nel sistema ERP (SAP R3/S4) e implementazione delle richieste di cambiamento e delle voci degli articoli

Il tuo profilo

• Idealmente, un ulteriore sviluppo come dipl federale. Compratore: in o paragonabile

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

• Esperienza con SAP R3/S4 e Excel

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our People & Organization team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Junior HR BP/ HR Project Specialist (80%, Fix-Term 16 months)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As Junior HR BP/HR Project Specialist you will support the Head Strategic People Partnering and HR HQ in delivering key HR projects and strategic business partnering deliverables. This 16-month fixed-term assignment combines project work with generalist HR responsibilities – ideal for someone who works in a structured way, takes ownership, and thinks about HR holistically. It offers deep insight into strategic HR work in a globally active life sciences company.

Your Responsibilities

HR Projects & Strategic Business Partnering Support (approx. 70%)

• Contribute to global and local HR projects and initiatives (e.g., organizational design, HR process improvements, change support)

• Prepare HR deliverables linked to strategic business partnering, such as business reviews, townhall materials, divisional HR presentations, decision papers, and communication documents

• Project planning and tracking: milestones, action logs, risks, status reports

• Prepare and follow up on workshops, steering committees, and stakeholder meetings

• Compile HR KPIs and people analytics (e.g., fill grades, attrition, pulse survey results)

HR Generalist (approx. 30%)

• Advise and support line managers on operational HR matters across the employee lifecycle, in coordination with the responsible HR Business Partners

• Support recruiting and onboarding processes

• Draft contracts, agreements, and HR documents

• Act as interface to HR Services, Payroll, Talent Acquisition, and Centers of Expertise

Salary: CHF 80’000

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Completed education with further qualification in HR (e.g., Swiss federal diploma in HR, CAS/Bachelor's degree in HR or Business Administration)

• 3–5+ years of experience as an HR Generalist, ideally in an international, matrix-organized environment

• Experience contributing to or leading HR projects

• Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills; confident working with HR systems (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday)

• Strong interest to push AI for HR usage

• Good knowledge of Swiss employment law; interest in international HR topics

• Excellent written and spoken English and German

• Structured, independent, and service-oriented way of working with a high level of discretion

• Available at short notice or within a reasonable timeframe for a 16-month assignment

What Sets You Apart

• You keep the overview even with parallel projects and tight deadlines

• You communicate effectively with all audiences – from the shop floor to senior management

• You combine a hands-on mentality with conceptual thinking

• Discretion and sensitivity in handling confidential topics come naturally to you

• W hat makes working at Tecan unique

• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Only applications that fully meet our requirements will be considered.

Ti sei mai chiesto come le tue abilità e il tuo background unico potrebbero influenzare il mondo di domani? Unisciti al nostro team People & Organization e porta la tua passione e talento al lavoro.

Junior HR BP/ HR Project Specialist (80%, Fix-Term 16 mesi)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In qualità di Junior HR BP/HR Project Specialist supporterai il Head Strategic People Partnering and HR HQ nella fornitura di progetti HR e business partner strategici. Questo compito a tempo determinato di 16 mesi combina il lavoro di progetto con le responsabilità generaliste delle risorse umane – ideale per qualcuno che lavora in modo strutturato, prende la proprietà, e pensa a HR olistico. Offre una profonda conoscenza del lavoro strategico delle risorse umane in una società di scienze della vita attiva a livello globale.

Le tue responsabilità

HR Projects & Strategic Business Partnering Support (circa 70%)

• Contribuire a progetti e iniziative HR globali e locali (ad esempio, progettazione organizzativa, miglioramenti del processo HR, sostegno ai cambiamenti)

• Preparare i materiali HR legati alla partnership strategica di business, come recensioni aziendali, materiali urbanhall, presentazioni HR divisionali, documenti decisionali e documenti di comunicazione

• Pianificazione e tracciamento del progetto: pietre miliari, registri delle azioni, rischi, rapporti di stato

• Preparare e seguire i workshop, i comitati di guida e le riunioni degli stakeholder

• Compile HR KPI e analisi delle persone (ad esempio, gradi di riempimento, attrito, risultati dell'indagine sul polso)

Generalista HR (circa 30%)

• Consigliare e supportare i gestori delle linee su questioni operative HR in tutto il ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, in coordinamento con i responsabili HR Business Partners

• Supporta processi di reclutamento e di imbarco

• Progetti di contratti, accordi e documenti HR

• Agire come interfaccia ai servizi HR, Payroll, Talent Acquisition e Centri di competenza

Salario: CHF 80’000

Il tuo sfondo

Non stiamo solo cercando competenze difficili: Stiamo cercando persone che portano la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

• Completato l'istruzione con ulteriore qualifica in HR (ad esempio, diploma federale svizzero in HR, laurea in CAS/Bachelor in HR o Business Administration)

• 3–5+ anni di esperienza come Generalista HR, idealmente in un ambiente internazionale matrice-organizzato

• Esperienza che contribuisce o conduce progetti HR

• Forte capacità di PowerPoint ed Excel; lavoro sicuro con i sistemi HR (ad esempio, SAP SuccessFactors, Workday)

• Forte interesse a spingere AI per l'utilizzo HR

• Buona conoscenza del diritto del lavoro svizzero; interesse per gli argomenti internazionali delle risorse umane

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese e tedesco

• Strutturato, indipendente e orientato al servizio, con un alto livello di discrezione

• Disponibile a breve preavviso o entro un termine ragionevole per un incarico di 16 mesi

Cosa ti distingue

• Tieni la panoramica anche con progetti paralleli e scadenze strette

• Si comunica efficacemente con tutti i pubblici – dal piano del negozio alla gestione senior

• Unisci una mentalità pratica con il pensiero concettuale

• La discrezionalità e la sensibilità nel trattare argomenti confidenziali vengono naturalmente a voi

• Cappello W fa lavorare a Tecan unico

• La possibilità di farlo contare e di avere un impatto sul mondo di domani

• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

• La possibilità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno dell'azienda

• Sentirsi potenziato dalla nostra cultura aziendale forte e unica

• Pacchetto completo di compensazione e benefici

Unisciti a Tecan, un ottimo posto per lavorare! Leggi la nostra recente certificazione da Great Place a Work .

Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione online. Si prega di inviare il CV o il curriculum (w/o foto e w/o lettera di presentazione, lettere di riferimento e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Saranno considerate solo le applicazioni che soddisfano pienamente i nostri requisiti.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Robotics team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Embedded Software Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and test embedded software modules and solutions for liquid handling and robotic applications. You will be involved in planning and developing software concepts, ensuring software quality, and troubleshooting. Your role will require interdisciplinary cooperation with electronics, software, and mechanics teams.

Responsibilities

• Plan, develop, and implement software concepts using modern C++ for embedded systems.

• Ensure software quality by applying latest tools and through systematic testing and error correction.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate software

• Evaluate new tools and methods and define coding standards and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, and regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485).

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering)

• Strong passion for embedded software engineering

• At least 5 years of professional experience with state-of-the-art software development using modern C++, preferably C++20

• Experience with advanced template metaprogramming

• Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), preferably POSIX-based operating systems

• Experience with communication interfaces and protocols such as SPI, CAN and QUIC and Ethernet-based protocols (e.g. UDP)

• Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Protobuf, CMake, Tracealyzer and Docker is a plus

• Experience in sensing technologies and motor control systems is a plus

• Strong sense of ownership with the motivation to take responsibility and drive projects to successful completion

• Good written and spoken English skills; German language skills is a plus

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

jobs.title: EHS Specialist
jobs.description:
Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unseres EHS / FM Teams und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

EHS-Spezialist / Sicherheitsbeauftragter 80-100%

Männedorf & Nänikon

Dein Beitrag
 Für unseren Standorte in der Schweiz suchen wir eine engagierte und kompetente Persönlichkeit als EHS-Spezialist / Sicherheitsbeauftragten. In dieser vielseitigen Funktion übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Umsetzung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer EHS Environment-, Health- & Safety-Organisation, des EHS-Managementsystems (ISO 14001 und 45001) sowie den Prozessen und trägst dazu bei, einen sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen.

• Verantwortung bzw. Koordination zu Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheitsschutz, Gefahrstoffe, Umwelt und Notfallorganisation

• Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des EHS-Managementsystems (ISO 14001 / ISO 45001) unter Einhaltung von Konzernvorgaben und gesetzlichen Anforderungen.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von gesetzlichen, behördlichen und internen Anforderungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Behörden, Fachstellen und Dienstleistern

• Beratung, Unterstützung und Schulung der Standortleitung, der Führungskräfte sowie der Mitarbeitenden in allen EHS-Bereichen

• Durchführung und Koordination von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, Risikoanalysen, Audits und Sicherheitsinspektionen

• Analyse von Unfällen, Ereignissen und Beinaheunfällen sowie Definition und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Erarbeitung und Monitoring von EHS-Kennzahlen und Management-Reports

Dein Profil
 Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Technische oder naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung sowie die Qualifikation als Spezialist ASGS oder Expert ASGS

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich EHS / Arbeitssicherheit, idealerweise in einem Industrieunternehmen

• Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau, der Weiterentwicklung und Auditierung von Managementsystemen nach ISO 14001 und ISO 45001

• Qualifikationen als Sicherheitsbeauftragter Brandschutz, Chemikalienansprechperson und Gefahrgutbeauftragter

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse der schweizerischen Gesetzgebungen und Anwendungen

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Durchsetzungsvermögen und gleichzeitig ausgeprägte Beratungs- und Kommunikationskompetenz

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Resilienz kombiniert mit einer pragmatischen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise.

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

• Eine verantwortungsvolle und vielseitige Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die Sicherheit und Nachhaltigkeit unseres Standortes

• Die Möglichkeit, EHS-Prozesse und die Sicherheitskultur aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Standortleitung und den verschiedenen Fachbereichen

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum

• Ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld in einem internationalen Industrieunternehmen
